Typography

round(16 x 1.2^n): 13, 16, 19, 23, 28, 33, 40px. Weights body 400, label 400, heading 600.

headline.lg 40/48 600Page and section titles.
headline.md 33/40 600Page and section titles.
headline.sm 28/36 600Page and section titles.
title.lg 23/32 600Card, panel and group titles.
numeric.lg 23/32 600Key numbers: balances, KPIs.
body.lg 19/28 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 19/28 600Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 16/24 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 16/24 400Button and control labels.
code.md 16/24 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 16/24 600Table headers, field-group titles.
numeric.md 16/24 400Amounts and table figures: tabular digits line up in columns; right-align numeric columns.
body.sm 13/20 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 13/20 400Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 13/20 400Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 13/20 400Inline values, dense code rows.
